dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?

dialogOption.emotions: villan voice, sarcastic. quite psychopath, but with litte reason
dialogOption.texten: You should listen to my demands, or you will have much bigger problems than you already have...
{WE WON'T NEGOTIATE} We do not negotiate with terrorists!
{STOP IT!} Stop it right now or you will face serious consequences!
{WHAT DO YOU WANT} Ok, what are your demands?
That is too bad. You will have some blood on your hands very soon...
Oh, I know the consequences and you should also know the consequences of NOT LISTENING TO ME!

I want my demands presented to the media: All the deportations of the so called 'illegal immigrants' must stop now, or more bombs will follow. If you want to send us back to the warzone, I will bring the warzone to you. I want to see my demands on every TV station in the city in 5 minutes.

I want my demands presented to the media: all the military activity of US Army outside its territory must stop now, or more bombs will follow. If you want to operate in the warzone, I will bring the warzone to you. I want to see my demands on every TV station in the city in 5 minutes.
{IS IT A POLITICAL REASON?} So you're doing this for political reasons?
Yes, I do it for all the refugees that are not welcome here, for all those that have no voice. I am the one that you have to reckon with!
Yes, people from my country have suffered enough. Those countless wars caused by US interference. . . It's about time that you start minding your own business, my fellow Americans!
{YOU'RE MAKING IT WORSE!} You will only make the things worse this way - far, far worse. You have to stop it now for the sake of your cause
I WILL TAKE THE BLAME...Don't you get it??? SOMETHING has to be done...something radical... only RADICAL actions can bring RADICAL CHANGE

dialogOption.emotions: angry again, strong accents on the capitals
dialogOption.texten: I WILL TAKE THE BLAME...Don't you get it??? SOMETHING has to be done... something radical... only RADICAL actions can bring RADICAL CHANGE in this country!
{OK, I WILL} Ok, I'll do what I can to arrange what you asking for.
{I CAN'T!} But I can't do that, I don't have the authority to make that decision!

dialogOption.emotions: slightly relieved, easier [car noises in background]
dialogOption.texten: Good boy. Then, I want a public declaration from the president that not a single person will be departed from the country.
Good boy. Then, I want a public declaration from the president that not a single American soldier will remain outside of the US borders.
{REPEAT PLEASE} I'm sorry, could you repeat that?
I said, I want THE PRESIDENT to say that NO ONE will be DEPORTED!!!
I said, I want THE PRESIDENT to say that NO American soldier will remain OUTSIDE YOUR BORDERS!!!
Of course you can. Just pass it on to your supervisor.
{YOU'RE INSANE} That's insane, it's impossible!
Just DO AS I SAY!!!
{IT MAKES NO SENSE} Really, a few bombs aren't gonna force the government to do what you want.
{I WILL PASS THAT ON} Ok, I will pass that on too.
You have 5 minutes. I will talk to you later.
{WE KNOW THE BOMB'S LOCATION} We already know where the bomb is!
Play for time again and you won't get a warning for the next bomb.
I mean it!

reportElement.texten: The bomber has called again to make his demands.
The caller has detonated the bomb, probably in panic.
The operator has failed to persuade nor talk the bomber out.
A cell phone was found in the car. Both were found out to be stolen.
